releases.name: v1.0.1
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## Highlights

- **Going Commando can be built and played from an installed launcher.** The launcher now downloads the game's source and builds it from your own disc (#276). Before this, an installed launcher had no Going Commando program and no way to make one, so its Play button asked for a rebuild over and over.
  - The first build takes a few minutes and needs a C compiler. On Linux it also needs SDL's development packages for X11, Wayland and audio; the README lists them.

releases.name: v1.0.2
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## Fixes

### Going Commando on Windows

- **Going Commando builds again on Windows.** Launcher 1.0.1 gave the build its bundled Python in a form Windows' command prompt can't start (`\\?\D:\...\python.exe`), so the build stopped with "The system cannot find the path specified". The launcher and the build now use the plain path, and a build that already failed this way is set right when you build again (#294).
